title: Implement functional tour/interview booking flow with auth, confirmation, and stored requests

requirements.text: Require Internet Identity sign-in for the Tours/Interviews booking page so that booking submission and viewing stored requests cannot fail silently due to missing authorization.

quotes: What happens when a parent books? I get nothing when I try

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /tours while signed out shows the existing AuthPanel (via RequireAuth) instead of the booking UI.
When signed in, the booking UI is available and booking submission calls the backend successfully (no authorization trap).

requirements.text: Fix the booking confirmation modal so it reliably appears after a successful submission and displays the correct submitted date/time, details, and booking ID.

quotes: What happens when a parent books? I get nothing when I try

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful booking submission, a confirmation modal is displayed without requiring any additional user action.
The modal shows the submitted date/time (not cleared/undefined), the submitted details, and the returned booking ID.
Closing the modal hides it and leaves the page in a ready state for another booking request.

requirements.text: Add a simple booking details form that collects parent contact information (name and email at minimum) along with optional notes, and ensure the submitted information is persisted with the booking request.
acceptanceCriteria: The /tours page includes inputs for parent name and parent email, plus the existing free-text notes field.
The submit button is disabled until required fields (date/time, name, email) are provided.
The backend persists the collected information with the booking request such that it is visible when listing bookings (e.g., in the 'Your Tour Requests' list).

requirements.text: Provide clear user-facing error feedback if booking submission fails (e.g., network/authorization issues), instead of only logging to the console.

quotes: What happens when a parent books? I get nothing when I try

acceptanceCriteria: If booking submission fails, the UI displays an English error message on the page (or in a modal/alert area) explaining that the request could not be submitted.
While submission is pending, the existing loading state remains visible and prevents duplicate submissions.

requirements.text: Ensure submitted bookings are stored and viewable from the UI by listing the signed-in user's tour requests on the /tours page and keeping the list up-to-date after creating a new request.
acceptanceCriteria: After submitting a booking, the stored requests list updates to include the new request without a full page reload.
The list displays each request's requested date/time, submitted details/contact info, and status.
If there are no bookings, the page does not show an empty list block (or shows a clear empty state message).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
All user-facing text added/changed must be in English.
Booking is for parent tours and enrollment interviews and must remain separate from the nanny cam livestream.
nonGoals: Do not implement any connection between booking requests and nanny-cam access rules.
Do not add email/SMS notifications or external integrations when a booking is created.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity).
Do not implement real-time updates (e.g., WebSockets).
